Below is a clip of the Nuggets rookie on draft day correctly pronouncing his name as he talks about delivering a banner to the Nuggets franchise.}} born April 17, 2001) is an American professional [[basketball]] player for the [[Denver Nuggets]] of the [[National Basketball Association]] (NBA). Braun plays the shooting guard position. A Kansas native, Braun won [[Mr. Kansas Basketball]] in 2019 and played [[College basketball|collegiately]] for the [[Kansas Jayhawks men's basketball|Kansas Jayhawks]]. Braun [[starting lineup|started]] for the Jayhawks squad that won the [[2022 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|2022 NCAA Division I championship]]. In the [[2022 NBA draft]], Braun was selected 21st overall by the Denver Nuggets. During his rookie season in Denver, the Nuggets defeated the [[Miami Heat]] and won their first NBA championship. Braun is the fifth player in basketball history to win an [[NCAA]] title and an NBA title in consecutive years.{{Cite web |last=Wimbish |first=Jasmyn |date=2023-06-13 |title=Nuggets' Christian Braun fifth player in basketball history to win NCAA, NBA titles in back-to-back seasons|url=https://www.cbssports.com/nba/news/nuggets-christian-braun-fifth-player-in-basketball-history-to-win-nba-ncaa-titles-in-back-to-back-seasons/ |access-date=2024-04-07 |website=CBS Sports |language=en}} ==High school career== Braun played basketball for [[Blue Valley Northwest High School]] in [[Overland Park, Kansas]]. As a senior, he averaged 27.8 points, 9.3 rebounds and 3.8 assists per game, leading the Huskies to a third straight Class 6A state title.{{cite web |last=Bedore |first=Gary |title=Braun fitting in well during summer session at KU: 'He really wants to learn' |url=https://www.kansas.com/sports/college/big-12/university-of-kansas/article232480832.html |website=[[The Wichita Eagle]] |access-date=May 29, 2021 |date=July 10, 2019}}{{cite web |last=Peterson |first=Rick |title=Three-time state champ Christian Braun turns focus to future at Kansas |url=https://www.cjonline.com/sports/20190316/three-time-state-champ-christian-braun-turns-focus-to-future-at-kansas |website=[[The Topeka Capital-Journal]] |access-date=May 29, 2021 |date=March 16, 2019}} He was named [[Mr. Kansas Basketball]] and Kansas [[Gatorade Player of the Year awards|Gatorade Player of the Year]].{{cite web |last=Chasen |first=Scott |date=May 1, 2019 |title=KBCA picks KU signee Christian Braun as Mr. Kansas Basketball |url=https://247sports.com/college/kansas/Article/KU-Jayhawks-signee-Christian-Braun-named-Mr-Kansas-Basketball-131700688/ |access-date=May 29, 2021 |website=[[247Sports]]}} He committed to playing college basketball for [[Kansas Jayhawks men's basketball|Kansas]] over offers from [[Kansas State Wildcats men's basketball|Kansas State]], [[Illinois Fighting Illini men's basketball|Illinois]] and [[Missouri Tigers men's basketball|Missouri]], among others.{{cite web |last=Bedore |first=Gary |title=Blue Valley NW's Christian Braun commits to KU. "It's always been a dream for me." |url=https://www.kansascity.com/sports/college/big-12/university-of-kansas/article218554050.html |website=[[The Kansas City Star]] |access-date=May 29, 2021 |date=September 17, 2018}} On April 4, 2022, the school declared that day Christian Braun Day.{{Cite web |last=Schmidt |first=Heidi |date=2022-04-05 |title=KU's Christian Braun honored by former high school |url=https://www.ksnt.com/sports/kansas-jayhawks/kus-christian-braun-honored-by-former-high-school/ |access-date=2022-04-05 |website=KSNT 27 News |language=en-US}} ==College career== As a freshman at the [[University of Kansas]], Braun averaged 5.3 points and 2.9 rebounds per game, earning [[Big 12]] All-Freshman Team honors.{{cite web |last=Lance |first=Sam |title=KU men's basketball guard Christian Braun looks to make impact, build on freshman season |url=https://www.kansan.com/sports/ku-mens-basketball-guard-christian-braun-looks-to-make-impact-build-on-freshman-season/article_5cba1af2-1ae8-11eb-a060-7f7b2a884ad4.html |website=[[The University Daily Kansan]] |access-date=May 29, 2021 |date=October 30, 2020}} On November 27, 2020, he recorded a career-high 30 points, nine rebounds and four steals in a 94–72 win over [[2019–20 Saint Joseph's Hawks men's basketball team|Saint Joseph's]].{{cite web |title=Small ball, Christian Braun help KU basketball race past Saint Joseph's 94-72 |url=https://www.cjonline.com/story/sports/2020/11/27/small-ball-christian-braun-help-ku-basketball-race-past-saint-josephrsquos-94-72/115059288/ |website=[[The Topeka Capital-Journal]] |access-date=May 29, 2021 |date=November 27, 2020}} As a sophomore, Braun averaged 9.7 points and 5.2 rebounds per game.{{cite web |title=#2 Christian Braun, Guard |url=https://kuathletics.com/roster/christian-braun/ |website=Kansas Athletics |date=10 July 2019 |access-date=May 29, 2021 |archive-date=February 17, 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240217133309/https://kuathletics.com/roster/christian-braun/ |url-status=dead }} He was named to the Second Team All-Big 12 as a junior.{{cite news |last=Guskey |first=Jordan |title=Kansas basketball's Ochai Agbaji named AP's Big 12 player of the year and he's not the only one getting honors |url=https://www.cjonline.com/story/sports/college/hawk-zone/2022/03/08/kansas-jayhawks-basketball-ochai-agbaji-ap-big-12-2022-player-year-first-team-all-conference/9404413002/ |access-date=March 10, 2022 |work=[[The Topeka Capital-Journal]] |date=March 8, 2022}} In the [[Final Four (college basketball)|Final Four]] against [[2020–21 Villanova Wildcats men's basketball team|Villanova]], he became the 65th player to reach 1,000 points for Kansas, finishing that game with 10 points and helping the Jayhawks reach the championship. In the [[2022 NCAA Division I men's basketball championship game|championship game]] against the [[2021–22 North Carolina Tar Heels men's basketball team|North Carolina Tar Heels]], he had 12 points and 12 rebounds for his fifth double-double of the season, which helped Kansas rally from a 40–25 halftime deficit. In the final possession of that game, he defended [[Caleb Love]]'s three-point attempt, sealing the win and giving his team an NCAA title.{{Cite web |last=Boyer |first=Zac |date=2022-04-05 |title=Christian Braun's big stop helps Kansas hold off North Carolina for title |url=https://www2.kusports.com/news/2022/apr/05/christian-brauns-big-stop-helps-kansas-hold-north- |access-date=2022-04-05 |website=KUsports.com |language=en}} On April 24, 2022, Braun declared for the [[2022 NBA draft]], while maintaining his college eligibility.{{cite web |last=Givony |first=Jonathan |date=April 24, 2022 |title=Kansas Jayhawks' Christian Braun to enter NBA draft but maintain college eligibility |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/33798301 |access-date=April 24, 2022 |website=ESPN.com}} On May 25, 2022, he confirmed he would remain in the NBA draft and forego his senior season.{{cite web |last=Cisneros |first=Juan |date=May 25, 2022 |title=Former Jayhawk Christian Braun to remain in NBA Draft |url=https://fox4kc.com/sports/college/jayhawks/former-jayhawk-christian-braun-to-remain-in-nba-draft/ |access-date=June 1, 2022 |publisher=fox4kc.com}} ==Professional career== === Denver Nuggets (2022–present) === Braun was picked by the [[Denver Nuggets]] with the 21st overall pick in the [[2022 NBA draft]]. On July 3, 2022, he signed his rookie scale contract with the Nuggets.{{Cite web |date=July 3, 2022 |title=Nuggets Sign Braun and Watson |url=https://www.nba.com/nuggets/news/nuggets-sign-braun-and-watson |access-date=April 11, 2023 |website=NBA.com}} He averaged 4.7 points per game in the [[2022-23 NBA season]].{{Cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/nba/player/stats/_/id/4431767/christian-braun|title=Christian Braun Career Stats |website=ESPN |access-date=November 16, 2025}} Braun won his first championship with the Nuggets after they defeated the [[2022–23 Miami Heat season|Miami Heat]] in the [[2023 NBA Finals]].{{cite web|url= https://clutchpoints.com/nuggets-news-christian-braun-joins-exclusive-club-with-magic-johnson-bill-russell-after-completing-epic-nba-ncaa-title-feat|title=Nuggets: Christian Braun joins Magic Johnson in exclusive Finals club|website=ClutchPoints|last=Pagaduan|first=Jedd|date=June 13, 2023|access-date=April 7, 2024}} He became the fifth player in NBA history to win an NCAA and NBA championship in back-to-back seasons; the other four are [[Bill Russell]], [[Henry Bibby]], [[Magic Johnson]] and [[Billy Thompson (basketball)|Billy Thompson]]. Braun played in all 82 games for the Nuggets during the [[2023-24 NBA season]], averaging 7.3 points per game.{{Cite web|url=https://www.nba.com/nuggets/news/nuggets-2023-24-season-in-review-christian-braun|title=Nuggets 2023-24 Season-In-Review: Christian Braun |website=NBA.com|last=Brooks|first=Matt|date=June 1, 2024}} Braun became the Nuggets' starting shooting guard before the [[2024-25 NBA season]] began.{{Cite web|url=https://nuggets.com/news/christian-brauns-2024-25-season-in-review|title=Christian Braun's 2024-25 Season In Review |website=NBA.com|last=Brooks|first=Matt|date=June 9, 2025}} He made 79 appearances (77 starts) for Denver that season, averaging 15.4 points, 5.2 rebounds, and 2.6 assists per game. On October 20, 2025, Braun and the Nuggets agreed to a five-year, $125 million contract extension.{{cite web |last=Charania |first=Shams |author-link=Shams Charania |date=2025-10-20 |title=Nuggets' Braun reaches 5-year, $125M extension |url=https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/46660934/nuggets-christian-braun-reaches-125m-extension-agent-says |access-date=2025-12-07 |website=ESPN.com}} On November 17, Braun was ruled out for at least six weeks due to a left ankle sprain suffered during a game against the [[2025–26 Los Angeles Clippers season|Los Angeles Clippers]].{{cite web |title=Nuggets' Christian Braun out indefinitely with ankle injury |url=https://www.nba.com/news/nuggets-guard-christian-braun-out-indefinitely-with-left-ankle-sprain |website=NBA |access-date=17 |url=https://www.kansascity.com/sports/college/big-12/university-of-kansas/article260156060.html |access-date=April 10, 2022 |website=The Kansas City Star}} His uncle played college basketball at His mother's family was inducted into the [[Missouri Sports Hall of Fame]].{{cite web |last=Battle |first=Bill |title=Braun Brothers Have Local Ties |url=https://www.emissourian.com/sports/braun-brothers-have-local-ties/article_49ca851e-4156-11eb-abf5-2b17db6b9f3d.html |website=[[Washington Missourian]] |access-date=May 29, 2021 |date=December 20, 2020}} Braun has launched a fashion line, The CB2 Collection.{{Cite web |last=Tait |first=Matt |date=February 15, 2022 |title=KU junior Christian Braun releases apparel line bearing his name {{!}} Tale of the Tait {{!}} KUsports.com |url=https://www2.kusports.com/weblogs/tale-tait/2022/feb/15/ku-junior-christian-braun-releases-appar |access-date=2022-04-05 |website=KUsports.com |language=en}} ==References== {{Reflist}} ==External links== {{commonscat}} *[https://kuathletics.com/sports/mens-basketball/roster/christian-braun/1006 Kansas Jayhawks bio] *[https://cb2hoops.com/ The CB2 Collection] {{Denver Nuggets current roster}} {{navboxes|list= {{2022 NBA draft}} {{2022 Kansas Jayhawks men's basketball navbox}} {{Denver Nuggets 2022–23 NBA champions}} }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Braun, Christian}} [[Category:2001 births]] [[Category:Living people]] [[Category:21st-century American sportsmen]] [[Category:American men's basketball players]] [[Category:American people of German descent]] [[Category:Basketball players from Kansas]] [[Category:Denver Nuggets draft picks]] [[Category:Denver Nuggets players]] [[Category:Kansas Jayhawks men's basketball players]] [[Category:People from Burlington, Kansas]] [[Category:Shooting guards]]
